title: Style
description: board: the in-game leaderboard list, meant to sit where osu! draws its own. rival: only the player above you, your position and the player below, with the score gaps.

title: Orientation
description: auto: a vertical list in tall boxes, a horizontal strip in wide ones (wider than 1.6× the height).

title: Alignment
description: Vertical layouts mirror for the right side of the screen (positions on the outer edge). Horizontal strips hug the left, right or centre of their box.

title: Backing
description: none: text straight on the game with a light shadow. scrim: a soft dark haze behind it. panel: a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map: highlight colour taken from the map's background. 18-lab: amber.

title: Board entries
description: Most entries shown (1–16, fewer when the box runs out). When you are below them, the top entries give way to the player you are chasing, you and the player behind you.

title: Board: compact
description: Shorter entries: one line per player in the list (position, name, accuracy, score); no accuracy/combo/mods line in the strip.

title: Board: show gap to next position
description: Score you need to pass the player above you, or your lead when you are first.
